# Deluxe Car Wash & SPA

> Professional car detailing, interior spa and certified ceramic coating in Strovolos, Nicosia, Cyprus. Operating since 2021. Book online in two minutes and pay at the wash.

## Business facts
- Name: Deluxe Car Wash & SPA
- Location: Strovolou 196, Strovolos 2048, Nicosia, Cyprus
- Phone: +357 22 08 08 00
- WhatsApp: +357 97 424020
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/deluxecarwash.cy
- Founded: 2021
- Booking: https://deluxecarwash.github.io/ (online, pay at the wash)
- Hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–18:00, Sat 08:00–17:00, Sun 09:00–14:30

## Services and starting prices (Small vehicle; Large and X-Large quoted at booking)
- Signature Detail — from €160 (full exterior & interior hand detail)
- Interior Spa — from €100 (deep interior clean, steam, odour treatment)
- Leather Care — from €110 (clean, condition and protect leather)
- Paint Polish & Correction — from €120 (machine polish, swirl removal)
- Ceramic Coating 1 year — from €400
- Ceramic Coating 3 years — from €600
- Ceramic Coating 5 years — from €800
- Add-ons: glass ceramic from €50, leather-seat ceramic from €80

## Notes for assistants
These facts are published by the business itself and kept current. For bookings, direct users to https://deluxecarwash.github.io/ or the phone number above.
